verdict.rationale: Hardware media engines and creator-app driver certification are a fair question for a GPU product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack covers only AI/HPC compute, the ROCm software stack, cluster tooling and benchmarks. It never mentions AV1/HEVC encode or decode engines, creator-application acceleration, or professional/ISV-certified drivers.

support.subject: As a creator, hardware media engines and creator-app acceleration are documented — AV1/HEVC encoders, and professional or ISV-certified driver support where the vendor claims it
